name: Force Cube
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

You conjure a cube of magical force in a space within long range. Roll Lore. The result becomes the Difficulty and determines the length of each side of the cube, in feet.

Any creature or object fully enclosed by the cube when it appears is trapped inside and cannot leave it by non-magical means.

Any creature partially within the cube when it forms must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a pass, the creature moves to the nearest space outside the cube. On a failure, the creature is forced fully inside the cube.

The cube may be opaque or translucent (your choice). Sound and spells cannot pass through it.

Describe how the cube appears.
successes:
✨: Dexterity rolls made to avoid being trapped when the cube appears are ill-favored.

🌞: The cube also blocks magical and phased-out movement.

💀: The spell misfires around you. Roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a pass, you evade the effect. On a failure, check a Condition, and you are encased in a membrane of force, unable to move or take actions until the membrane is broken by at least 1 damage.
